$comment: Machine-readable reel beats. record.js reads this; assemble.sh reads this. Edit beats here, not in the recorder.

beats.caption: Design a custom theme
beats.prompt: Build a minimal photography portfolio block theme — dark hero with a single large headline, a 3-column image gallery, and system serif headings. Use sd-ai-agent/scaffold-block-theme with slug=aperture-portfolio, then sd-ai-agent/activate-theme. Reply only with: THEME READY.

beats.caption: Write SEO posts + images
beats.prompt: Write a 600-word SEO blog post titled "Choosing your first prime lens" with a clear intro, three subheadings, and a conclusion. Generate a fitting featured image, attach it, and publish the post. Reply only with: POST PUBLISHED.

beats.caption: Generate brand assets
beats.prompt: Generate a minimalist black-on-white SVG logo for 'Aperture & Light Studio' using a single geometric aperture mark. Save it as the site logo (custom_logo). Reply only with: LOGO SAVED.

beats.caption: Build entire plugins
beats.prompt: Build a custom plugin called 'Auto Watermark' that hooks 'wp_handle_upload' and overlays a small text watermark 'aperture-light.studio' onto the bottom-right corner of every uploaded JPEG/PNG using GD. Scaffold the plugin, install and activate it. Reply only with: PLUGIN ACTIVE.

beats.caption: Audit your SEO
beats.prompt: Audit the homepage SEO of this site. List the top three fixes — each with the file or setting to change and the exact value to use. Reply only with the numbered list.
